title: Intel CEO Tan Makes Bold Move – Shares Atom Chip Tech With Rosaic, A Startup Led By His former Investment Partner
content: Chip manufacturer Intel is providing its Atom chip technology to a startup run by a former associate of CEO Lip-Bu Tan, says a report from Reuters. Tan, along with having significant experience in the semiconductor industry, is also a well-known venture capital investor. The startup, called Rosaic, is run by Amarjit Gill, who invested with Tan in high-performance chip startup Nuvia and worked together in establishing RISC-V chip company Rivos.
